content.comment_body: How can I modify the on/off times for the timer using the [product_name] display? I'm new to [product_name] PLCs, so I'd appreciate guidance.
Hello [user_name], Could you clarify what you mean by "on/off time of the timer"? Are you referring to a weekly timer?
I need to adjust the ON time of the timer through the [product_name] display. I am using an on/off timer.

The timer you referenced functions as an on/off delay type. If the timer parameters are available in a message text, follow these steps: Ensure the [product_name] is running. To change a parameter, select the relevant message text. Hold the ESC key for more than 2 seconds, and a black bar appears in the input/output field. Use the cursor up/down to navigate through the fields. Choose the field you want to edit and press the OK button (on [product_name] panel > Enter). The black bar then becomes a blinking box. Use the cursor up/down to adjust the value, and the cursor left/right to change position. Once finished, press the OK button again to return to the black bar. You can select another field or press ESC to exit the operation.

analysis.insight_summary: A new user of the [product_name] PLC is unsure how to directly change timer settings through the display. Adjusting on/off timer parameters feels unintuitive, likely due to minimal guidance and a complex interface for beginners.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates straightforward and easily understandable instructions for modifying timer ON/OFF values from the [product_name] display, hoping for a more user-friendly process.
